rubric_additions.rubric-22:
Rule: Instrumentation: implement and run the selected producer/bridge checks.
Example: With logs set to otlp and traces set to console, an SDK span dump must not become an application LogRecord.
Evidence: Record a compatibility decision for each selected SDK console writer on logs, traces and metrics, even when no global console bridge is added. Use a proven compatible application producer, or record the added console-to-OTLP route as Not configured/unsupported. Preserve operator SDK exporters and native output. Run the selected SDK console writers and prove their output is not captured as application LogRecords, including selected deferred-Resource resolution or direct-SDK emission paths. Prove the supported application bridge still emits its expected record in the normal profile. Do not add a second or incompatible bridge or remove an operator exporter to hide extra records.
Insufficient evidence: Guarding only the logs selector; treating an omitted bridge as working application logging; processor construction alone; dropping an operator console exporter; or testing only an immediate console write when deferred Resource output is selected.
